sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Classic Grey Glass Bangle Set with Golden Ghoonghroo Accents – 16-Piece
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your ethnic grace with this stunning set of 12 grey glass bangles and 4 golden ghoonghroo bangles. This fashionable ensemble adds a melodic charm to your movement. To preserve the brilliant golden luster of the charms, keep them away from moisture and store safely in a dry place.
To ensure safe delivery, prepaid payment is mandatory as this is a fragile item
